title: SidMesh capability contract
description: contracts/<verb>.v<version>.json inside a node directory. One file per capability version. Semantic rules that JSON Schema cannot express are listed in SPEC.md (codes CON_*).

capability.description: <nodeId>.<verb>. Must start with the id of the node that owns it.

version.description: Incompatible changes get a new version in a new file; callers move explicitly.

kind.description: action: deterministic or integration work. ai: returns a suggestion with a confidence and can sit behind a gate.

effects.description: none: reads or computes only. write: changes something outside the engine and must declare idempotency and lookup.

config.description: Schema of per-tenant configuration bound by the definition (thresholds, endpoints names, toggles). Never secrets.

outcomes.description: Every way the capability can finish successfully, each with its own output schema. failed and unknown are reserved for the engine.

idempotency.description: Required when effects is write. Input paths whose values together identify one logical write.

lookup.description: Required when effects is write. A capability of the same node that, given the same input, reports what an earlier attempt did. Used to resolve unknown.

ledger.description: Fields recorded in the learning ledger for every call. Keep to what the decision needs; no personal data unless the decision uses it.

defaults.description: Execution defaults a definition may override per step.

objectSchema.description: A JSON Schema 2020-12 for an object. The strict profile in SPEC.md (rule CON_SCHEMA_STRICT) is checked by the validator, not here.
